items.title: Chester Zardis Interview, 1970-02-14
items.q: I went out to Denver, Colorado, in a giant Floyd Hunts band... I stood with them a long time.

ctx.x: Yeah. Did you play much then when you got back?

Yes, I played a whole lot when I got back, because when I first got back, this man of Gabriel, know that I got back and he came to my house and seen me, asked me if I wanted to work with him. He had a regular job playing at Mississippi City. That's, you know, I don't know if you know where that's at. That's way on the other side of, well, that's way away from Covington. But it's, I mean, it's a different route, you know what I mean? Well, anyhow, I played with him a long time over there, so, and that's the a long…
When would you say that the music here in New Orleans was, like, speaking, it's fine?
